integrity: The proof, finite checks, exact boundary cases, and comparison limits are supplied in the complete package.
scientific_limitations: Only uniform permutations on n>=3 and the cycle containing the smallest label are studied.
Individual conditional descent probabilities, not conditional joint independence, are proved.
The first public date belongs to the selected motivating arXiv preprint; background work predates it.
Historical distinguished-cycle generating functions could contain an implicit specialization; specialist priority review remains appropriate.
Computational tests through n=9 do not substitute for the infinite proof; independent validation has not been performed.
title: Boundary-localized descents and the cycle length of a marked element
